declarations.name: Breadcrumb

declarations.componentDescription: Breadcrumb component for graph and subgraph navigation. Use this interactive visual graph surface when composing canvas UI. declarations.name: CanvasGraph
declarations.description: Generic hierarchical graph overview/read renderer with force layout, semantic navigation, selection events, and optional device-orientation parallax.
declarations.componentDescription: Generic hierarchical graph overview/read renderer with force layout, semantic navigation, selection events, and optional device-orientation parallax. Use this interactive visual graph surface when composing canvas UI. Capabilities: hierarchical-graph, overview-read-renderer, force-layout, semantic-clusters, focus-selection, layout-snapshot, viewport-control, device-orientation-parallax. Data ownership: host-owned model; component renders and emits intent events. WebMCP tools: canvas_graph_set_model, canvas_graph_focus_node, canvas_graph_focus_nodes, canvas_graph_set_path.

attributes.name: active-node-scale
attributes.description: Visual scale target for the selected node; defaults to 1.5.

attributes.name: info-panel-scale
attributes.description: Visual scale for the active node information panel; defaults to 1.

attributes.name: device-orientation-parallax
attributes.description: Requests device-orientation parallax on the first user gesture.

attributes.name: device-orientation-parallax-strength
attributes.description: Maximum parallax offset in CSS pixels.

attributes.name: device-orientation-parallax-max-tilt
attributes.description: Tilt angle that maps to full parallax strength.

attributes.name: device-orientation-parallax-absolute
attributes.description: Requests absolute orientation permission when available.

members.name: graphDB
members.description: Normalized graph store created from graph-model-v1 data.

members.name: currentGroupId
members.description: Current drilled group id, or empty at root.

members.name: activeNode
members.description: Currently focused graph node.

members.name: renderMode
members.description: Graph rendering mode, such as dots or cards.

members.name: layoutSettled
members.description: Whether the current force-layout run reached its deterministic settled state.

members.name: activeNodeScale
members.description: Visual scale target for the selected node; defaults to 1.5.

members.name: infoPanelScale
members.description: Visual scale for the active node information panel; defaults to 1.

members.name: setGraphModel
members.description: Loads normalized graph data into the canvas renderer.

members.name: setPath
members.description: Navigates to a group path or semantic cluster path.

members.name: flyToNode
members.description: Focuses a node by id and enters parent groups when needed; accepts optional viewportEase for slower camera tracking.

members.name: flyToNodes
members.description: Fits one or more visible graph node ids into the canvas viewport; accepts optional viewportEase for live replay tracking.

members.name: fitNodes
members.description: Fits one or more visible graph node ids into the canvas viewport; accepts optional viewportEase for live replay tracking.

members.name: focusNodes
members.description: Agent-facing alias for fitting one or more graph node ids into the viewport.

members.name: activateNode
members.description: Immediately activates a node by id without moving or targeting the viewport; defaults skip transition markers and it returns false for a missing or unknown id.

members.name: queueTransitionMarkers
members.description: Queues animated route markers from one graph node to multiple target node ids without changing the host-owned graph model.

members.name: fitView
members.description: Fits the visible graph into the canvas viewport; accepts optional viewportEase for live replay tracking.

members.name: getViewport
members.description: Returns the current zoom and pan viewport as a portable snapshot.

members.name: setViewport
members.description: Applies an absolute, clamped zoom and pan viewport immediately or through the graph camera easing loop.

members.name: setVisualOptions
members.description: Applies visual tuning options such as activeNodeScale and infoPanelScale without changing the host-owned graph model.

members.name: pulseNode
members.description: Projects a timed pulse around one node, optionally from an explicit render-clock start time.

members.name: clearPulses
members.description: Clears active and queued node pulses.

members.name: animateNodeAppearance
members.description: Replays node appearance animation for visible graph nodes or a supplied node id set.

members.name: setFrameDriver
members.description: Switches canvas presentation between the self-scheduled animation loop and an external frame driver.

members.name: presentFrame
members.description: Synchronously presents the current externally driven canvas state without starting a competing animation-frame loop.

members.name: resetView
members.description: Resets viewport pan and zoom.

members.name: resetLayoutState
members.description: Clears force layout positions, transition markers, pulses, and persisted layout snapshot before deterministic replay restarts.

members.name: setLayoutSnapshot
members.description: Restores persisted graph node positions and viewport state.

members.name: getLayoutSnapshot
members.description: Returns serializable node positions and viewport state.

members.name: getRenderSnapshot
members.description: Returns snapshot v3 render-continuation state for a settled layout, including full-precision positions, render-surface identity, camera, focus, animation, selection, transition, pulse, group-orbit, appearance, and info-panel state.

members.name: setRenderSnapshot
members.description: Atomically restores a valid snapshot v3 on an equivalent backing/CSS/DPR render surface, invalidates stale layout work, and returns whether the snapshot was applied.

members.name: getDeviceOrientationParallaxStatus
members.description: Returns current device-orientation parallax support, permission, and enabled state.

members.name: enableDeviceOrientationParallax
members.description: Enables device-orientation parallax as a progressive enhancement after user activation.

members.name: disableDeviceOrientationParallax
members.description: Disables device-orientation parallax and removes sensor listeners.

members.name: suspendLayout
members.description: Marks the graph as layout-suspended so internal layout moves do not trigger destructive teardown.

members.name: resumeLayout
members.description: Resumes graph drawing and theme sync after layout suspension.

members.name: applyWheelZoom
members.description: Applies wheel zoom at client coordinates through the shared clamp, zoom-anchor, and wake-loop path.

declarations.name: ChatWorkspace
declarations.description: Reusable chat workspace shell that composes sidebar, transcript, composer, leading controls, voice intents, footer controls, transient overlay reserve, and animated background lifecycle.
declarations.componentDescription: Reusable chat workspace shell that composes sidebar, transcript, composer, leading controls, voice intents, footer controls, transient overlay reserve, and animated background lifecycle. Use this chat and conversation surface when composing chat UI. Capabilities: chat-workspace, chat-sidebar-composition, chat-transcript-composition, chat-composer-composition, chat-nav-tree-helper, voice-intent-router, leading-control-intent-router, footer-control-intent-router, context-intent-router, animated-background-lifecycle, overlay-stack-reserve, message-windowing, layout-lifecycle, host-owned-transport. Data ownership: host-owned props and attributes; component owns presentation state. WebMCP tools: chat_workspace_set_state, chat_workspace_background, chat_workspace_select_chat, chat_workspace_send.

attributes.name: sidebar
attributes.description: Set to hidden to hide the composed sidebar surface.

attributes.name: empty
attributes.description: Centers the composed composer and hides the transcript while the host has no messages.

members.name: chats
members.description: Host-owned nested chat descriptors forwarded to chat-sidebar-shell; hosts can use buildChatNavTree() to derive this product-neutral tree.

members.name: activeChatId
members.description: Host-owned active chat id used to mark sidebar selection.

members.name: messageItems
members.description: Normalized transcript message descriptors forwarded to chat-transcript.

members.name: composer
members.description: Composer state including value, context chips, footer controls, sending state, voice controls, and voice preview.

members.name: voiceControls
members.description: Host-owned voice control state forwarded to chat-composer.

members.name: backgroundState
members.description: Host-owned activity, streaming, or idle state mapped to cell-bg trigger/start/stop lifecycle.

members.name: overlayStackReserve
members.description: Host-owned bottom transient overlay stack reserve in CSS pixels.

members.name: setWorkspaceState
members.description: Applies host-owned chat workspace state without owning transport, routes, persistence, or API calls.

members.name: setChats
members.description: Sets nested chat descriptors and active selection state using the same product-neutral normalization as buildChatNavTree().

members.name: setActiveChatId
members.description: Marks a host-owned chat id active in the composed sidebar.

members.name: setEmpty
members.description: Sets the host-owned empty conversation presentation state.

members.name: setMessages
members.description: Sets transcript message descriptors and optionally scrolls to bottom.

members.name: setComposerState
members.description: Sets composer value, context chips, leading controls, footer controls, disabled/sending state, voice controls, and voice preview; changed non-empty values refresh background activity.

members.name: setVoiceControls
members.description: Sets visible voice control state while hosts may override or allow browser VoiceRuntime behavior.

members.name: setVoicePreview
members.description: Shows a voice transcription preview supplied by the host or browser VoiceRuntime.

members.name: clearVoicePreview
members.description: Clears the voice transcription preview.

members.name: setOverlayStackReserve
members.description: Sets bottom transient overlay stack reserve so transcript padding and scroll controls avoid floating surfaces.

members.name: setLiveStatus
members.description: Renders host-provided live status metadata and optionally drives background state.

members.name: setBackgroundState
members.description: Maps host activity or streaming state to cell-bg trigger/start/stop lifecycle.

members.name: triggerBackground
members.description: Triggers a timed animated background pulse.

members.name: startBackground
members.description: Starts persistent animated background activity with smooth acceleration.

members.name: stopBackground
members.description: Stops animated background activity with smooth deceleration.

members.name: suspendLayout
members.description: Stops composed background work while preserving host-owned chat state for hidden layout groups.

members.name: resumeLayout
members.description: Restores persistent background activity when the host resumes a hidden layout group.

members.name: getSidebar
members.description: Returns the composed chat-sidebar-shell element.

members.name: getTranscript
members.description: Returns the composed chat-transcript element.

members.name: getComposer
members.description: Returns the composed chat-composer element.

members.name: getBackground
members.description: Returns the composed cell-bg element.

members.name: messageWindow
members.description: Visible transcript window metadata forwarded to chat-transcript for paged message loading.

members.name: replaceMessageWindow
members.description: Replaces the visible transcript message window with host-owned window metadata.

members.name: prependMessages
members.description: Prepends older transcript message descriptors while preserving the current scroll anchor.

members.name: getMessageWindow
members.description: Returns the composed transcript message window metadata.

tools.name: panel_layout_set_behavior

tools.description: Register a host-owned panel type descriptor; rendering policy and data loading remain outside symbiote-ui.

tools.name: panel_layout_set_panel_menu_actions
tools.description: Set explicit fold-down panel menu actions; built-in actions distinguish Close for minimizing temporary UI-invoked panels from Remove for physical split-tree removal, plus horizontal split, vertical split, and duplicate.

tools.name: panel_layout_open_panel
tools.description: Open or reuse a host-approved panel type inside the current layout tree; use uiInvoked when the panel should be closeable/minimizable as a temporary UI surface.

tools.name: panel_layout_close_ui_panel
tools.description: Close a panel only when it was opened as a UI-invoked temporary surface; close marks the panel closed/collapsed and leaves host-owned panels and layout groups intact.

tools.name: panel_layout_remove_ui_panel
tools.description: Physically remove a UI-invoked temporary panel from the layout tree; the last temporary panel may restore the captured host layout.

declarations.name: CascadeThemeEditor
declarations.description: Reusable cascade theme editor module for host layouts.
declarations.componentDescription: Reusable cascade theme editor module for host layouts. Use this layout-hosted cascade theme control surface when composing theme UI. Capabilities: cascade-theme-controls, theme-variants, tab-shape-controls, geometry-registers, locale-controls, scope-apply-all, scope-picking, copy-parameters, share-request, reset-defaults, local-storage, layout-panel. Data ownership: component-owned normalized theme state persisted through host-selected localStorage key; reset removes cascade-owned storage keys after applying defaults. WebMCP tools: cascade_theme_editor_apply.

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Optional localStorage key used for automatic theme parameter persistence.

attributes.name: target-selector
attributes.description: Optional CSS selector for the theme cascade target. Defaults to documentElement.

attributes.description: Optional JSON object or parameter string used as the reset fallback state.

attributes.description: Optional CSS selector for host elements the editor can add as individual theme targets.

attributes.name: share-label

declarations.name: KanbanBoard
declarations.description: Generic themeable kanban board for host-owned columns, cards, actions, selection, and move intents. Card actions render behind a native `popover` + anchor-positioned sn-dropdown (reused from menu/) so the menu floats over the board instead of reflowing the card; the card summary clamps to a fixed line count and the footer chip row wraps instead of clipping.
declarations.componentDescription: Generic themeable kanban board for host-owned columns, cards, actions, selection, and move intents.
